body_markdown:
WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE:GVA) announced today that the GO3JV joint venture has been awarded a new task order under the Guam Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC). The project will construct key components of the Guam Defense System (GDS) Forward Operating Sites on Guam for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC). The task order is valued at approximately $165 million and will be included in third quarter CAP.


The project includes site preparation, utility installation, facility construction, transportation improvements, and related infrastructure. These enhancements will support operational readiness and continuous mission requirements.


“This award demonstrates the continued growth of Granite’s Federal business and our ability to secure significant new work with a long-standing client,” said Granite Federal Division VP Curt Haldeman. “Building on decades of experience with NAVFAC, the project strengthens our position in a market that supports national security and offers additional opportunities for sustainable growth.”


Construction is anticipated to begin in 2026, with completion expected in late 2029.


**About Granite**


Granite is America’s Infrastructure Company™. Incorporated since 1922, Granite (NYSE:GVA) is one of the largest diversified construction and construction materials companies in the United States as well as a full-suite civil construction provider. Granite’s Code of Conduct and strong Core Values guide the Company and its employees to uphold the highest ethical standards.
